subject_matter_word_matches_reviewed.meaning: Describes MCMC draws or pairs after warm-up.

proof_gaps.title: Wold representation by the closed linear past
proof_gaps.reason: The page explains innovation orthogonality and verifies an MA(1) and a stationary harmonic. A complete Hilbert-space construction of the infinite moving-average representation and deterministic component remains to be supplied.

proof_gaps.title: Convergence to the one-neighbour limiting risk
proof_gaps.reason: The article derives the risk inequalities from the limiting conditional-label formula and explains its continuity argument. The general Euclidean nearest-neighbour convergence argument, including measurable distance ties, remains to be supplied.

proof_gaps.title: Regular finite-chain convergence to the uniform stationary law
proof_gaps.reason: The article proves uniform invariance and checks a regular-chain example, but does not give the general regular finite-chain convergence proof.

proof_gaps.title: Poisson convergence for unequal independent Bernoulli probabilities
proof_gaps.reason: The article proves the identical-probability binomial case. Its stated triangular-array extension is cited to Durrett Thm.3.6.1 without a full independent-array proof.

proof_gaps.title: Exact normal-sample Hotelling F calibration
proof_gaps.reason: The page derives and checks ellipsoid geometry and numerically applies the stated normal-sample F calibration; a full Wishart/independent-mean derivation of that calibration is not given.

proof_gaps.title: Slater constraint qualification and strong duality
proof_gaps.reason: The article proves weak duality and derives the SVM dual; it cites the general Slater strong-duality theorem without its separation argument.

proof_gaps.title: Convergence for a countable irreducible aperiodic positive recurrent chain
proof_gaps.reason: The local contraction proof establishes finite-state convergence only. The countable-state extension is stated from Durrett §5.6 Thm5.6.6 and needs the recurrence/coupling argument.

proof_gaps.title: Long-run visit proportions for an irreducible positive recurrent chain
proof_gaps.reason: State-frequency convergence is stated from Durrett §5.6 Thm5.6.1, separately from distributional convergence; its return-cycle strong-law proof is not included.

proof_gaps.title: Poisson arrivals see stationary occupancy probabilities
proof_gaps.reason: The finite occupancy distribution is derived by detailed balance. The general nonanticipating Poisson-arrival sampling theorem is stated from Wolff (1982), §§1–2, without reproducing its martingale proof.

proof_gaps.title: A characteristic function uniquely determines its probability law
proof_gaps.reason: The article derives basic transform identities and a finite-law worked example. General uniqueness via Fourier inversion is stated from Durrett §3.3.1 and is not proved.

proof_gaps.title: Pointwise transform convergence and continuity at zero imply weak convergence
proof_gaps.reason: The continuity theorem is stated with its continuity-at-zero hypothesis from Durrett Thm. 3.3.17; the tightness and inversion proof is not reproduced.

proof_gaps.title: Gumbel limit for independent normal maxima
proof_gaps.reason: The page proves the exact exponential maximum limit. The normal-tail comparison cites Durrett Exercise 3.2.3 but does not establish its tail-ratio asymptotics.

proof_gaps.title: Convergence of finite irreducible aperiodic transition powers
proof_gaps.reason: The page proves existence, positivity and uniqueness of the stationary law and derives the two-state limit. The general aperiodic convergence and return-time theorems are cited to Durrett §§5.5–5.6 rather than proved.

proof_gaps.title: Stationary masses equal reciprocal mean return times
proof_gaps.reason: The page applies the return-time identity from Durrett Theorem 5.5.11; its local proof establishes stationary existence and uniqueness without deriving this renewal identity.

proof_gaps.title: Extension of consistent finite-dimensional laws
proof_gaps.reason: The page verifies finite Bernoulli consistency and Markov marginalisation; the measure-extension existence argument for arbitrary consistent laws is stated with Durrett Appendix A.3 as its source.

proof_gaps.title: Hull–Dobell full-period theorem
proof_gaps.reason: The full-period conditions are stated with Hull and Dobell (1962), Theorem 1, p. 233. The page checks two finite cycles rather than proving the modular-arithmetic characterization.

proof_gaps.title: Variance of the unbiased sample variance
proof_gaps.reason: The page proves unbiasedness and the sample-mean moments. The fourth-central-moment formula for Var(S²) is cited to Siegrist and checked by finite enumeration for a discrete population; its general combinatorial proof is not included.

proof_gaps.title: Full asymptotic Laplace approximation with tail control
proof_gaps.reason: The article evaluates the Gaussian surrogate exactly and checks an exact gamma-integral example; a general analytic proof controlling Taylor remainders and contributions outside the dominant peak is still required.

proof_gaps.title: Regular likelihood-ratio chi-square calibration for nested GLMs
proof_gaps.reason: The article proves the exact Gaussian orthogonal-coordinate case; the general regular-model likelihood asymptotic expansion and convergence proof remain to be supplied.

proof_gaps.title: General two-sample Hotelling F calibration
proof_gaps.reason: The page proves affine invariance and the scalar t-squared case; the multivariate normal/Wishart derivation for arbitrary dimension is cited to the proper full-text papers rather than derived.

proof_gaps.title: Weakest-link pruning gives the nested optimal-subtree path
proof_gaps.reason: The page proves penalty monotonicity of leaf counts and the single-branch breakpoint identity. The full optimal-subtree guarantee for successive weakest-link pruning is cited to Loh2014 but has no local structural proof.
